summary: Baidu filed a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return (US equivalent: an ongoing share-repurchase disclosure) covering buybacks executed on the HKEX from September 7 to September 24, 2026. Daily repurchases of roughly 541,200-576,400 Class A ordinary shares were made at prices between HKD 86.7309 and HKD 92.383, totaling about 7.8 million shares (~0.35% of the 2,209,541,178 issued shares outstanding) for cancellation. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The structural overhang to monitor is cancellation timing and pace; watch whether buybacks continue at similar daily sizes.
